title: The Cipher of Little Hawley
author: Edmund Okafor
blurb: Beatrix Nakamura, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
